title: mb-proto-http-proxy
description: Pure HTTP/1.1 proxy request-head codec. L7 adapters project decoded target intent into bus sessions; core receives opaque payload bytes.

connect_target.description: CONNECT accepts only authority-form target `uri-host:port`; origin-form or absolute-form CONNECT targets are rejected.

forward_proxy_target.description: Non-CONNECT forward-proxy requests accept absolute-form http:// URI and are rewritten to origin-form before upstream relay.

header_bound.description: The parser returns HeaderTooLarge before unbounded request-head buffering.

opaque_after_connect.description: This crate parses no bytes after the CONNECT request-head; tunneled payload remains opaque.
